correctness.rationale: The proof derives exact 3-adic polynomial identities in three residue branches, proves two are isometries and the third is globally conjugate to 3/128 plus three times a square. value.rationale: The fourth fixed binomial column and the ramified prime three form a canonical gap beyond published surjectivity and good-prime image results. Exact target multiplicities at every prime-power modulus, the sole critical output 3/128, a one-eighth enhancement set and an integrable unbounded density are substantial structural information that neither surjectivity nor finite modular tables determine.
